SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS title, p.est_duration AS estDuration, p.applicant_count AS applicantCount, p.budget AS budget, c.company_name AS companyName, u.name AS clientName, DATEDIFF(p.deadline_date, CURDATE()) AS dday, CASE WHEN #{userId} IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_bookmarks pb WHERE pb.project_id = p.project_id AND pb.user_id = #{userId} ) END AS bookmarked FROM projects p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.client_id JOIN client_profiles cp ON cp.client_id = p.client_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = cp.company_id WHERE p.is_public = TRUE AND p.project_status = 'READY'
ORDER BY
p.budget DESC, p.created_at DESC p.deadline_date ASC, p.project_id DESC p.created_at DESC, p.project_id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.project_id) FROM projects p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.client_id JOIN client_profiles cp ON cp.client_id = p.client_id WHERE p.is_public = TRUE AND p.project_status = 'READY'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE created_at >= CURDATE() AND created_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE project_status = 'READY' AND deadline_date >= CURDATE() AND deadline_date < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 8 DAY)
